messages:
incident-bot: Paging: latency-slo-alert / streaming-stalls / p99 > SLA (link: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/3322114455) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: summary: p95=120ms (baseline 110ms) p99=620ms (baseline 140ms) streaming stall rate +15% in last 10m. affected shards: eu-west-1-rtpool, us-east-1-burst. triggered: auto-paging to #incidents.
Sanjay R: oncall assign? I'm around for triage, pinging ops bridge.
ops-bridge-bot: Bridge created: https://bridge.redwood/3322114455 — Maria K (oncall-engineer) is invited. Use /runbook quant-calib-tail for playbook.
Maria K: I'm on it. quick triage: correlation with recent calib rollout `int8-calib-v12` ~2h ago. looking at streaming traces and kv-cache eviction logs. starting targeted queries for tail sessions.
Keaton: throwing up timeline: calib rollout at 09:02 UTC, p99 jump at 09:05 UTC. here's a snippet from traces: ```
# service:streaming-proxy
# tag: int8-calib-v12
p99_latency: 620ms
tail_stalls: 18.2% (prev 3.4%)
error_rate: 0.7% (up from 0.02%)
```
Maria K: good catch. initial hypothesis: calibration changed kernel codepath for small-batch dequantization which increases CPU-GPU sync and KV-cache thrash on long contexts -> streaming stalls. mitigation plan: 1) move traffic off int8-calib-v12 to fallback fp16/int8-safe variant, 2) scale dedicated pool for streaming by +2 nodes in eu-west-1, 3) enable streaming-fallback-routing immediate. executing step 1 now.
Derek O: I can patch routing. running admin api: ```bash
# switch route for model: redwood/llama-xxl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/svc/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"selector":"int8-calib-v12","action":"redirect","target":"llama-xxl-fp16-safe","percent":100}'
```
Derek O: applied. confirmed config commit id: cfg-plant-7782.
Maria K: monitoring metrics. initial check: p99 dropped from 620ms -> 240ms in 30s (still above SLA). starting pool scale.
Keaton: logs show KV cache churn spikes at rollout time. example from node 12: `kvcache.evictions: 452 / 1m` and `dequant.alloc-failures: 12` — aligns with memory layout changes in the new kernel.
Maria K: scaled eu-west-1 streaming pool +2 nodes, capacity increment id: scale-3322. routing switch + scale both in effect. re-evaluating SLOs.
Tasha: customer-impact note: Customer A (high-throughput chat) reported repeated streaming stalls and reconnects between 09:04–09:12 UTC. CS notified and triage ticket created: CS-7819. sending proactive note.
Sanjay R: any regression in generation quality from fallback fp16? need to confirm.
Keaton: sampling outputs — fp16 fallback shows negligible quality delta for the affected prompt set (automated eval on seed 120 shows BLEU/ROUGE delta <0.5%). safe for immediate routing.
Maria K: p99 now ~160ms, p95 ~125ms, streaming stall rate down to 3.9%. still monitoring for sticky sessions. marking incident as mitigated for customer-facing outages but will keep bridge open for follow-up.
Derek O: posting deploy timeline and diff: `int8-calib-v12` changed quant scale heuristic in dequant.cc -> introduced extra memcpy for 1-token hot paths. reverting commit in CI and initiating rollback candidate.
Maria K: temp mitigation ticket created to revert calib in canary: ROLLBACK-332211. owners: research/infra/serving.
Tasha: CS update sent: "We've routed your traffic to a stable model variant and restored streaming performance; team is investigating calibration change. We'll follow up with RCA."
Sanjay R: action items for postmortem: - full RCA (why canary didn't catch tail stalls) - tighten canary traffic shape to include long-context streaming sessions - add synthetic tail tests for quantized dequant paths - automate fallback routing when p99 > X for 3m. assign owners.
Maria K: I'll own immediate follow-ups: RCA writeup and rollback verification. Keaton/Research to own quant kernel review. Derek to own routing/fallback automation improvements. Tasha to coordinate CS comms and customer postmortem invites.
Derek O: handing off monitoring to night oncall (Derek O -> oncall-nite). leaving notes in runbook.
ops-bridge-bot: Bridge will be closed in 1h unless re-opened. logs and timeline exported to https://incidents.redwood/3322114455/export (includes perf charts & config diffs).
Sanjay R: thanks all — good quick mitigation. keep any follow-up threads in #incidents-postmortem and link to this bridge. :thumbsup: 
Maria K: last note — mark `int8-calib-v12` as blocked from auto-rollout until RCA complete. tagging research for prioritization. :warning:
Derek O: accepted handoff, setting reminder for rollback smoke at 02:00 UTC.
Tasha: creating JIRA: RWI-332211 (Customer impact, postmortem, RCA). added CS-7819 link.
incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> monitoring. alert window: 09:04–09:13 UTC. p99 peak 620ms.
Maria K: closing thread on bridge — moving to follow-up doc. please add any residual notes below.
